recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit the surrounding guidance only if the broader Triaged R6 follow-up FHIR-54592 reaches a final applied or published decision.
issue_request: FHIR-37924 was a Published FHIR-core ObservationDefinition change request resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested adding Boundaries and Relationships language explaining that ObservationDefinitions are only for describing observation contents, including observations in order catalogs or panels, and that Questionnaire should be used when additional structure, sequence, or rules are needed.
initial_application: The Jira comment says the issue was applied to the build in PR commit 3422d966b9f77843fa84c6799925f96b86186a9d. In the current local history, commit cd6e8ac1026c0a391ceb3363e313b776122d198c added the relevant paragraph to source/observationdefinition/observationdefinition-introduction.xml on 2023-03-08, and current blame still attributes the paragraph to that commit.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists ObservationDefinition and maps observationdefinition to the ObservationDefinition resource, confirming the inspected introduction source is in current build scope. The current Questionnaire introduction already has parallel text comparing Questionnaire and ObservationDefinition. OO Confluence minutes from 2023-03-07 record the FHIR-37924 Persuasive with Modification motion and R5 QA timing. A later Jira search found FHIR-54592 as a broader R6 guidance request, but it is Triaged and not a final applied or published decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source already includes the requested ObservationDefinition paragraph and no discovered final later decision conflicts with it.
